

# expand.exe is all Rust (expand-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/expand-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# expand.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/expand-rust/src/expand/expand.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(expand_c OBJECT rust_varargs_shim.c)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(expand_res OBJECT expand.rc)
target_include_directories(expand_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(EXPAND_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/CMakeFiles/oldnames.dir/oldnames.a)
add_cargo_module(expand expand-cargo expand.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE expand-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS expand_c expand_res ${EXPAND_REUSED})
